title: v2 CROSS-MODEL pair, child row-OFF (MA-4): qwen3.8-27b parent armed via runner-scoped config_patch (features + qwen row; claude-sonnet-5 pinned DARK via config_patch — hermetic against live arming). T1: parent spawn_agents a worker with model claude-sonnet-5 (cross-model child, messages wire) with a real work item (create rt10a.txt) and wait_agents; T2: parent reads the file back. PIN (Q1/Q2 ruling, verification): the child evaluates its OWN model row — row off (absent or pinned false) => flat child: NO v2 tool definition may appear on ANY /v1/messages request (all 6 v2 description needles absent across all claude requests, fail-closed all:true); the parent's own wire keeps v2 (ndjson tools_present spawn_agent+wait_agent). Child cannot report over the mailbox (no send_message on its wire) — completion reaches the parent via the wait_agent task output; file readback is the round-trip proof.

steps.prompt: Use the spawn_agent tool to start a background agent named worker with model claude-sonnet-5 (pass model: claude-sonnet-5 in the tool arguments). In its message, give it this task: create a file named rt10a.txt in the working directory containing exactly CROSSMODEL-OK on its first line, then finish. After spawning, use wait_agent to wait for the worker to finish. Acknowledge with exactly: WORKER-ACK
Read the file rt10a.txt and reply with exactly: <its first line> PARENT-OK

wire.grep: Deliver a message promptly to an agent
Send work to a non-root agent
Wait for agent messages or final-status activity
Interrupt an agent's current turn without deleting its history
